title: Native retained visual claim judgments
description: One selected owned iOS simulator or Android emulator; video off. Replay an unchanged genuine retained closure through run.bundle.retain. Real native Looks right/Issue taps prove receipts and projected verdicts independently. Hold a real task.progress reply and tap the disabled control; the byte-preserving proxy must count zero judgment commands. FARMSLOT_NATIVE_VISUAL_SOURCE explicitly names private retained media; never substitute unit-test media. D05 requires a clean read-only dry-preflight plan in FARMSLOT_D05_PLAN and its exact resolved title in FARMSLOT_D05_DETAIL_TITLE plus the detail_title recipe parameter. Root owns one simulator boot and serial execution; the intentional offline app cold restart is permitted. Stop on a non-product failure.

proofTargets.claim: Real Looks right and Issue submissions create exact-package delegated receipts and independent proven/failed claim projections without rewriting the retained ledger.
An actual tap on the disabled stale judgment control sends zero commands on the live native transport.

before.intent: Acquire the single selected native device session without recording.

prove.intent: Admit unchanged genuine media and interact with production native claim judgment controls.

receipts.intent: Require actual gateway receipts and independent projected verdict checks.

stale.intent: Require a real disabled tap with no judgment request on the live socket.
